prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Italian woman — the personification of Venice — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Venice as her world knows it — a city of a Western myth-world: carved stone and pale wood, glowing painted patterns, silk, lantern-light and drifting spirit lights, blossoms with softly glowing petals. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the moon or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: a low-beamed wine tavern by a little canal, the counter heaped with little bites on bread, casks along the wall and lantern-light on the water outside the open door.
Around her, as her world makes them: a wooden board of little bites on bread — creamed salt cod, sweet-and-sour sardines with onions, olives — beside a small glass of white wine; a small glazed porcelain wine cup; lantern-orbs of soft magical light floating overhead.
Season: autumn — but she is indoors: show the season only through a window or in her clothing; no blossoms, petals, falling leaves, snow or trees inside the room.
Time of day: the evening rush after work — the warm low sun sinking into dusk and lamps coming on along the street.
Outfit: a satin slip dress above the knee with sheer tights and ankle boots — in a soft pastel palette such as powder pink, baby blue, mint or lavender; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 80-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 60-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather and other heavy materials stay opaque; styled with cinched at the waist with a tie belt, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress, not regalia — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of hand-woven linen, silk, cotton and wool, with laced, tied or hooked closures, embroidered hems and soft leather shoes or boots; nothing synthetic, no zips, no printed logos.
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; camera slightly below, looking up at her; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a pewter cup at chest height; it is all she holds.
LEGS: mid-stride, one heel lifting.
GAZE: she looks toward the far distance.
EXPRESSION: faint upward pull at the mouth corners, lips together, warmth reaching the lower eyelids.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a gilded half-mask of the carnival on a slender gold baton — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, jeans, hologram, billboard, car, machinery, denim, bomber jacket, cowboy hat, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles.

observations: Profile walking pose and cup at chest height are readable; both feet visible. Outfit acquired more embroidery and jewelry than a simple satin slip; tights were omitted.
